Item: Silver Fang

+1 Longsword

The Silver Fang is the trademark weapon of the Order of the Argent Wolf. Fully initiated members are presented with it upon completion of their initiation, normally around level 5 (initiation required to take further level in EK).

The sword bears a silver pommel with an ornately carved wolf’s head on the pommel piece. The crossguard bears intricately carved designs that remind the viewer of wolf’s hair and the end of the crossguard into stylized wolf’s paws. The blade bears intricate knotwork style engraving and runes along it’s blade. The Silver Fang also bears a silvered edge.
